## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md: Developer Certificate of Origin)
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and clippy on the crates I touched are clean; tests added for logic changes
- [ ] No new network connection, or it is listed in PRIVACY.md and has a setting
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data in the diff or in test fixtures
- [ ] Nothing that solves CAPTCHAs, forges fingerprints or evades bot detection
